description: AUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRES_IN is set to 30d in our environment, but POST /api/v1/auth/refresh starts returning 401 for clients as soon as the short access-token lifetime has passed. Decoding a freshly issued refreshToken shows its exp is only minutes after iat.
data_flow: getTokensData signs the access token with auth.secret/auth.expires and the refresh token with auth.refreshSecret and an expiresIn that must come from auth.refreshExpires (AUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRES_IN)
The refresh JWT exp therefore equals the access token lifetime, and JwtRefreshStrategy rejects it after expiry
fix: Use the 'auth.refreshExpires' config key for the refresh token expiresIn.
notes: Shared helper getTokensData is used by login, social login and refresh. The config key for the second signAsync call was swapped to the access-token key. The access-token expiry computed at the top is correct.
adjudication: removed JwtRefreshStrategy.validate and the config validator property (not on the cause path; READS edge absent in buggy code)
